assignment_help_requests_source_check.name: assignment_help_requests_source_check
assignment_help_requests_source_check.value: NOT ("assignment_help_requests"."submission_id" IS NOT NULL AND "assignment_help_requests"."objective_submission_id" IS NOT NULL)

assignment_item_history_policy_check.name: assignment_item_history_policy_check
assignment_item_history_policy_check.value:
("assignment_item_history"."policy_mode" = 'any' AND "assignment_item_history"."required_version_id" IS NULL) OR
      ("assignment_item_history"."policy_mode" = 'exact' AND "assignment_item_history"."required_version_id" IS NOT NULL)

assignment_items_requirement_check.name: assignment_items_requirement_check
assignment_items_requirement_check.value:
("assignment_items"."requirement" = 'accepted' AND "assignment_items"."minimum_score" IS NULL) OR
    ("assignment_items"."requirement" = 'min_score' AND "assignment_items"."minimum_score" IS NOT NULL AND "assignment_items"."minimum_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)

assignment_items_published_policy_check.name: assignment_items_published_policy_check
assignment_items_published_policy_check.value:
("assignment_items"."published_policy_mode" = 'any' AND "assignment_items"."published_required_version_id" IS NULL) OR
    ("assignment_items"."published_policy_mode" = 'exact' AND "assignment_items"."published_required_version_id" IS NOT NULL)

assignments_schedule_check.name: assignments_schedule_check
assignments_schedule_check.value: "assignments"."state" <> 'scheduled' OR ("assignments"."publish_at" IS NOT NULL AND "assignments"."scheduled_by" IS NOT NULL)

community_moderation_actions_workspace_c.name: community_moderation_actions_workspace_check
community_moderation_actions_workspace_c.value:
("community_moderation_actions"."target_type" IN ('message', 'user_ban') AND "community_moderation_actions"."domain_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("community_moderation_actions"."target_type" NOT IN ('message', 'user_ban') AND "community_moderation_actions"."domain_id" IS NOT NULL)

community_notifications_workspace_check.name: community_notifications_workspace_check
community_notifications_workspace_check.value:
("community_notifications"."type" IN ('reply', 'like', 'moderation', 'clarification') AND "community_notifications"."domain_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("community_notifications"."type" IN ('follow', 'ban') AND "community_notifications"."domain_id" IS NULL)
        OR "community_notifications"."type" = 'report'

community_posts_binding_required_check.name: community_posts_binding_required_check
community_posts_binding_required_check.value:
("community_posts"."type" = 'solution' AND "community_posts"."domain_problem_binding_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("community_posts"."type" <> 'solution' AND "community_posts"."domain_problem_binding_id" IS NULL)

community_posts_context_check.name: community_posts_context_check
community_posts_context_check.value:
(
        ("community_posts"."type" = 'solution' AND "community_posts"."problem_id" IS NOT NULL AND "community_posts"."board_id" IS NULL AND "community_posts"."title" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("community_posts"."type" = 'discussion' AND "community_posts"."board_id" IS NOT NULL AND "community_posts"."problem_id" IS NULL AND "community_posts"."title" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("community_posts"."type" = 'moment' AND "community_posts"."problem_id" IS NULL AND "community_posts"."board_id" IS NULL AND "community_posts"."title" IS NULL)
      )

community_reports_workspace_check.name: community_reports_workspace_check
community_reports_workspace_check.value:
("community_reports"."content_type" = 'message' AND "community_reports"."domain_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("community_reports"."content_type" IN ('post', 'comment') AND "community_reports"."domain_id" IS NOT NULL)

community_reports_category_check.name: community_reports_category_check
community_reports_category_check.value: "community_reports"."category" IN ('违法违规', '人身侵权', '涉嫌欺诈', '侵权抄袭', '垃圾信息', '站外风险引流', 'AI生成内容问题', '其他')

contest_problems_effective_version_polic.name: contest_problems_effective_version_policy_check
contest_problems_effective_version_polic.value:
("contest_problems"."effective_version_mode" = 'any' AND "contest_problems"."required_version_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("contest_problems"."effective_version_mode" = 'exact'
            AND "contest_problems"."required_version_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND "contest_problems"."required_version_id" = "contest_problems"."pinned_version_id")

contests_time_format_check.name: contests_time_format_check
contests_time_format_check.value:
"contests"."start_time" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]{3}Z$'
        AND "contests"."end_time" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]{3}Z$'
        AND ("contests"."freeze_start_time" IS NULL OR "contests"."freeze_start_time" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]{3}Z$')
        AND pg_input_is_valid("contests"."start_time", 'timestamptz')
        AND pg_input_is_valid("contests"."end_time", 'timestamptz')
        AND ("contests"."freeze_start_time" IS NULL OR pg_input_is_valid("contests"."freeze_start_time", 'timestamptz'))

domain_limits_bounds_check.name: domain_limits_bounds_check
domain_limits_bounds_check.value: ("domain_limits"."members" IS NULL OR "domain_limits"."members" >= 0) AND ("domain_limits"."problems" IS NULL OR "domain_limits"."problems" >= 0) AND ("domain_limits"."storage_bytes" IS NULL OR "domain_limits"."storage_bytes" >= 0) AND ("domain_limits"."submissions_per_minute" IS NULL OR "domain_limits"."submissions_per_minute" >= 0)

domain_llm_settings_selection_check.name: domain_llm_settings_selection_check
domain_llm_settings_selection_check.value: ("domain_llm_settings"."provider_id" IS NULL AND "domain_llm_settings"."model" IS NULL) OR ("domain_llm_settings"."provider_id" IS NOT NULL AND "domain_llm_settings"."model" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("domain_llm_settings"."provider_id")) > 0 AND length(trim("domain_llm_settings"."model")) > 0)

domain_problem_bindings_policy_check.name: domain_problem_bindings_policy_check
domain_problem_bindings_policy_check.value: ("domain_problem_bindings"."effective_version_mode" = 'any' AND "domain_problem_bindings"."required_version_id" IS NULL) OR ("domain_problem_bindings"."effective_version_mode" = 'exact' AND "domain_problem_bindings"."required_version_id" IS NOT NULL)

domain_storage_uploads_result_check.name: domain_storage_uploads_result_check
domain_storage_uploads_result_check.value: ("domain_storage_uploads"."state" = 'settled' AND "domain_storage_uploads"."storage_url" IS NOT NULL AND "domain_storage_uploads"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("domain_storage_uploads"."state" = 'released' AND "domain_storage_uploads"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("domain_storage_uploads"."state" = 'reserved' AND "domain_storage_uploads"."finished_at" IS NULL)

education_notifications_source_check.name: education_notifications_source_check
education_notifications_source_check.value:
("education_notifications"."type" IN ('assignment','assignment_changed','resource_unavailable') AND "education_notifications"."feedback_id" IS NULL AND "education_notifications"."help_id" IS NULL AND "education_notifications"."reply_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("education_notifications"."type" = 'feedback' AND "education_notifications"."feedback_id" IS NOT NULL AND "education_notifications"."help_id" IS NULL AND "education_notifications"."reply_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("education_notifications"."type" = 'help' AND "education_notifications"."feedback_id" IS NULL AND "education_notifications"."help_id" IS NOT NULL AND "education_notifications"."reply_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("education_notifications"."type" = 'help_reply' AND "education_notifications"."feedback_id" IS NULL AND "education_notifications"."help_id" IS NOT NULL AND "education_notifications"."reply_id" IS NOT NULL)

objective_submissions_version_origin_che.name: objective_submissions_version_origin_check
objective_submissions_version_origin_che.value:
("objective_submissions"."version_origin" = 'known' AND "objective_submissions"."submitted_version_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("objective_submissions"."version_origin" = 'legacy_unknown' AND "objective_submissions"."submitted_version_id" IS NULL)

problem_binding_history_policy_check.name: problem_binding_history_policy_check
problem_binding_history_policy_check.value: ("problem_binding_history"."effective_version_mode" = 'any' AND "problem_binding_history"."required_version_id" IS NULL) OR ("problem_binding_history"."effective_version_mode" = 'exact' AND "problem_binding_history"."required_version_id" IS NOT NULL)

problems_effective_version_policy_check.name: problems_effective_version_policy_check
problems_effective_version_policy_check.value:
("problems"."effective_version_mode" = 'any' AND "problems"."required_version_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("problems"."effective_version_mode" = 'exact' AND "problems"."required_version_id" IS NOT NULL)

submission_version_results_submission_kn.name: submission_version_results_submission_known_unique
submission_version_results_submission_kn.where: "submission_version_results"."submission_id" IS NOT NULL AND "submission_version_results"."problem_version_id" IS NOT NULL

submission_version_results_objective_kno.name: submission_version_results_objective_known_unique
submission_version_results_objective_kno.where: "submission_version_results"."objective_submission_id" IS NOT NULL AND "submission_version_results"."problem_version_id" IS NOT NULL

submission_version_results_submission_un.name: submission_version_results_submission_unknown_unique
submission_version_results_submission_un.where: "submission_version_results"."submission_id" IS NOT NULL AND "submission_version_results"."problem_version_id" IS NULL

submission_version_results_objective_unk.name: submission_version_results_objective_unknown_unique
submission_version_results_objective_unk.where: "submission_version_results"."objective_submission_id" IS NOT NULL AND "submission_version_results"."problem_version_id" IS NULL

submissions_version_origin_check.name: submissions_version_origin_check
submissions_version_origin_check.value:
("submissions"."version_origin" = 'known' AND "submissions"."submitted_version_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("submissions"."version_origin" = 'legacy_unknown' AND "submissions"."submitted_version_id" IS NULL)
